stories.title: Generate Time-Limited QR Code for Offer Redemption
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to generate a time-limited QR code for my selected offer so that I can present it to the merchant for redemption.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a consumer selects 'Redeem' on an active offer, WHEN the QR code screen loads, THEN a unique QR code is generated with a 5-minute expiry timestamp encoded
GIVEN the QR code is displayed, WHEN the screen renders, THEN device brightness is set to maximum automatically
GIVEN the QR code is displayed, WHEN time elapses, THEN a visible countdown timer shows remaining seconds until expiry
GIVEN the countdown reaches zero, WHEN the QR expires, THEN the QR code is invalidated and the consumer is prompted to regenerate
GIVEN the QR code screen is displayed, WHEN a screen reader is active, THEN the countdown is announced at 60-second intervals and at 10 seconds remaining
GIVEN the QR code screen is displayed, WHEN rendered, THEN the QR code has a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 and a text alternative describing its purpose

stories.title: QR Code Generation Error Handling
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want clear feedback when QR code generation fails so that I understand what went wrong and can retry.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a network error occurs during QR generation, WHEN the request fails, THEN an error message is displayed with a 'Retry' button
GIVEN the offer has already been redeemed, WHEN the consumer attempts to generate a QR, THEN a message states the offer is no longer available
GIVEN the offer has expired, WHEN the consumer attempts to generate a QR, THEN a message states the offer has expired with a link to browse new offers
GIVEN an error message is displayed, WHEN a screen reader is active, THEN the error is announced via an ARIA live region with role='alert'

stories.title: Server-Side Duplicate Redemption Prevention
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want the system to prevent duplicate redemptions so that each offer can only be used once as intended.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a redemption request is received, WHEN the server processes it, THEN a unique constraint on (offer_id, consumer_id) prevents duplicate entries
GIVEN a duplicate redemption request is received, WHEN the unique constraint is violated, THEN the server returns an idempotent success response (HTTP 200) with the original redemption record
GIVEN concurrent redemption requests for the same offer, WHEN processed simultaneously, THEN only one redemption is recorded and the second receives the idempotent response
GIVEN a redemption is attempted on an expired QR code, WHEN the server validates the timestamp, THEN the request is rejected with a 410 Gone status

stories.title: Offer History with Tabbed Status View
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to view my offers organised by status (active, redeemed, expired) so that I can track my offer activity.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the consumer navigates to Offer History, WHEN the screen loads, THEN three tabs are displayed: Active, Redeemed, Expired with counts
GIVEN the Active tab is selected, WHEN offers are listed, THEN they are sorted by expiry date ascending (soonest first)
GIVEN the Redeemed tab is selected, WHEN offers are listed, THEN each shows the redemption date, merchant name, and savings amount
GIVEN any tab is selected, WHEN a filter is applied (date range, merchant, category), THEN the list updates to show matching offers only
GIVEN the tabs are rendered, WHEN navigated via keyboard, THEN ARIA tablist/tab/tabpanel roles are correctly applied and arrow keys move between tabs
GIVEN the consumer has redeemed offers, WHEN the history screen loads, THEN a total savings counter is displayed at the top

stories.title: Automated Offer Expiry Batch Processing
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want expired offers to be automatically updated so that my offer list always reflects current availability.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the batch job runs every 15 minutes, WHEN offers have passed their expiry datetime, THEN their status transitions from 'active' to 'expired'
GIVEN an offer will expire within 1 hour, WHEN the batch job identifies it, THEN an 'expiring soon' push notification is sent to the consumer
GIVEN the batch job processes offers, WHEN a status transition occurs, THEN an audit log entry is created with timestamp and previous/new status
GIVEN the batch job fails, WHEN an error occurs, THEN it is retried with exponential backoff (max 3 retries) and an alert is raised to operations

stories.title: Expiring Soon Notification Preferences
stories.user_story: As a consumer, I want to control whether I receive 'expiring soon' notifications so that I am not overwhelmed by alerts.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the consumer accesses notification settings, WHEN they toggle 'Expiring Soon Alerts', THEN the preference is persisted and respected by the batch job
GIVEN the consumer has disabled expiring soon alerts, WHEN the batch job identifies an expiring offer, THEN no notification is sent for that consumer
GIVEN the toggle control is rendered, WHEN a screen reader is active, THEN the toggle has an accessible label and announces its current state

stories.title: Merchant QR Code Scanning and Redemption Confirmation
stories.user_story: As a merchant marketer, I want to scan a consumer's QR code and receive confirmation of a valid redemption so that I can honour the offer with confidence.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the merchant opens the scan screen, WHEN the camera activates, THEN the QR scanner is ready within 2 seconds
GIVEN a valid QR code is scanned, WHEN the server validates it, THEN a green confirmation screen displays offer details, consumer reference, and timestamp
GIVEN an expired or already-redeemed QR is scanned, WHEN the server rejects it, THEN a red rejection screen displays the reason (expired/already used)
GIVEN a successful redemption is confirmed, WHEN the merchant sees confirmation, THEN the consumer receives a real-time push notification confirming redemption
GIVEN the merchant is offline, WHEN a QR code is scanned, THEN a 6-digit offline fallback code is displayed for manual entry later
GIVEN the confirmation/rejection screen is displayed, WHEN a screen reader is active, THEN the result is announced immediately via an ARIA live region

stories.title: Merchant Offline Fallback Code Reconciliation
stories.user_story: As a merchant marketer, I want offline fallback codes to be reconciled when connectivity is restored so that redemptions are not lost.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the merchant regains connectivity, WHEN pending offline codes exist, THEN they are automatically submitted to the server for validation
GIVEN an offline code is submitted, WHEN the server validates it, THEN the redemption is recorded and the consumer is notified retrospectively
GIVEN an offline code has expired beyond a 24-hour grace period, WHEN submitted, THEN it is rejected and the merchant is notified to contact support
Given a screen reader is active, When the merchant scans a QR code and confirmation appears, Then the redemption status is announced clearly
